coverage_note_en: Forty questions across all twenty-four levels, matching the blueprint's Modules 12-15 mock size of 40Q (the original 30Q build predates that sizing). Levels 21 to 24 fall past the last checkpoint, so questions 16-25 remain their primary assessment. Questions 31-40 close the last content gap: levels 2, 6, 8, 13 and 16 had never been drawn on by any earlier question, despite each carrying a load-bearing point (the missing-correlative error recurring across जो/जब/जहाँ, and the subjunctive-vs-indicative distinction across अगर/चाहे/शायद/ताकि).

sentences: एक आदमी वहाँ खड़ा है।
वह डॉक्टर है।
options: जो आदमी वहाँ खड़ा है, वह डॉक्टर है।
जो आदमी वहाँ खड़ा है डॉक्टर है।
आदमी जो वहाँ खड़ा है वह डॉक्टर है।
वहाँ खड़ा आदमी जो डॉक्टर है।
questions.explanation_en: Without वह the first half has nothing to attach to.

questions.stem: ___ बेटा डॉक्टर है, वह मेरी पड़ोसन हैं।
questions.stem_read_as: ___ beṭaa ḍôkṭar hai, vah merii paṛosan haiṁ.
questions.explanation_en: जिसका agrees with बेटा, the thing possessed, not with the woman who possesses him.

sentences: जिन लोगों ने मदद की, उन्हें धन्यवाद।
जो लोगों ने मदद की, उन्हें धन्यवाद।
questions.explanation_en: ने is a postposition, so both जो and लोग go oblique.

questions.sentence: जैसे ही घंटी बजी, सब खड़े हो गए।
questions.sentence_read_as: jaise hii ghanṭii bajii, sab khaṛe ho gae.
options: A compound conjunction that takes no answer
questions.explanation_en: Supplying वैसे ही would change it to "in the same manner".

questions.stem: जब तक मैं ___ लौटूँ, तुम यहीं रहना।
questions.stem_read_as: jab tak maiṁ ___ lauṭuuṁ, tum yahiiṁ rahnaa.
questions.explanation_en: जब तक takes न with the subjunctive and नहीं with the indicative, but always takes one of them.

sentences: तुम्हारे पास कुछ पैसा है।
उतना ही ख़र्च करो।
options: जितना पैसा है, उतना ही ख़र्च करो।
जितनी पैसा है, उतना ही ख़र्च करो।
जितना पैसा है, उतना ख़र्च ही करो।
questions.explanation_en: The last moves ही onto ख़र्च, so it emphasises spending rather than the amount.

questions.sentence: अगर देर हो जाए तो फ़ोन कर देना।
questions.sentence_read_as: agar der ho jaae to fon kar denaa.
options: A real condition with the subjunctive, leaving it genuinely open
questions.explanation_en: The subjunctive leaves the lateness a possibility. A future would assert it.

sentences: अगर तुम नहीं आए तो मैं अकेला चला जाऊँगा।
अगर तुम नहीं आते तो मैं अकेला चला जाऊँगा।
options: The second — if a real condition is meant
questions.explanation_en: नहीं आते is the imperfect, which makes the condition unreal and clashes with the real future in the second half.

questions.stem: अगर तुम ___ बताते तो मुझे पता ही नहीं चलता।
questions.stem_read_as: agar tum ___ bataate to mujhe pataa hii nahiiṁ chaltaa.
questions.explanation_en: A counterfactual condition takes न; its consequence takes नहीं. The asymmetry is worth learning as a pair.

questions.sentence: अगर उस दिन बता देते तो आज ये हाल न होता।
questions.sentence_read_as: agar us din bataa dete to aaj ye haal na hotaa.
options: A past condition with a past consequence
A past condition with a present consequence, in one verb form used twice
questions.explanation_en: English needs two constructions for this. Hindi does not distinguish "if I went" from "if I had gone".

sentences: मेरी इच्छा है।
आप आएँ।
options: मैं चाहता हूँ कि आप आएँ।
मैं चाहता हूँ कि आप आएँगे।
questions.explanation_en: चाहना takes the subjunctive after कि, never the future.

questions.sentence: हो सकता है कि वो न आए।
questions.sentence_read_as: ho saktaa hai ki vo na aae.
options: An impersonal way of raising a possibility
questions.explanation_en: हो सकता है never changes for who is being discussed. It is about the situation, not the person.

sentences: डॉक्टर ने कहा कि आराम करें।
डॉक्टर ने कहा कि आराम कीजिए।
questions.explanation_en: कीजिए is addressed to somebody. Inside a report there is nobody to address, so the subjunctive takes over.

questions.sentence: राहुल ने कहा कि मैं थक गया हूँ।
questions.sentence_read_as: raahul ne kahaa ki maiṁ thak gayaa huuṁ.
options: The speaker asked Rahul a question
Rahul said something, and separately the speaker is tired
questions.explanation_en: कि introduces reported speech, so everything after it belongs to Rahul. Hindi resolves this by convention rather than grammar.

sentences: वो हँस रहे थे।
वो अंदर आए।
questions.explanation_en: हँसकर would mean he laughed and then came in — a sequence rather than two things at once.
The perfective participle describes a thing in a settled state, and it agrees with feminine किताब.

sentences: वो कुर्सी पर बैठा है।
वो कुर्सी पर बैठ रहा है।
options: Neither — but the second means he is lowering himself onto it
questions.explanation_en: Positions in Hindi are states. बैठ रहा है is the act of sitting down, not the state of being seated.

options: One action then the next, with a single subject for both
questions.explanation_en: -कर chains actions and requires the same subject. If the subjects differ you need के बाद.
करना is the one verb that cannot take plain कर, because that would give कर कर.

sentences: खाना खाने के बाद हम निकले।
खाना खाना के बाद हम निकले।
questions.explanation_en: के बाद is a postposition, so the infinitive in front of it goes oblique. Module 6, applied to a verb.

questions.sentence: उनके जाने के बाद मैं पहुँचा।
questions.sentence_read_as: unke jaane ke baad maiṁ pahuṁchaa.
options: This could equally be said with -कर
This cannot be said with -कर, because the two actions have different subjects
questions.explanation_en: -कर has no way to carry its own subject. That is the practical reason के बाद survives alongside a shorter form.
Both halves of a passive agree with the subject, and रिपोर्ट is feminine.

sentences: रिपोर्ट अधिकारी के द्वारा भेजी गई।
रिपोर्ट अधिकारी ने भेजी गई।
questions.explanation_en: A passive has no ने, because the agent is no longer the subject.

options: I am not allowed to eat this much
I find myself unable to eat this much
I do not want to eat
questions.explanation_en: The capability passive is about something in you refusing, which is not the same as सकना's plain inability.

options: It states what will happen without naming who
It names who will do the work
questions.explanation_en: Removing the agent is the point of the construction rather than a side effect, which is why notices and reports use it constantly.

questions.sentence: वो हमेशा की तरह साढ़े नौ बजे आए और अपनी जगह बैठ गए।
questions.sentence_read_as: vo hameshaa kii tarah saaṛhe nau baje aae aur apnii jagah baiṭh gae.
options: Two compound verbs in a narrative past
questions.explanation_en: From Module 13's final narrative. आए and बैठ गए, and the vector on the second marks the settling.

sentences: जब तक तुम यहाँ हो, कोई चिंता नहीं।
जब तक तुम यहाँ नहीं हो, कोई चिंता नहीं।
options: The second — if "as long as you are here" is meant
questions.explanation_en: जब तक takes नहीं for "until" and drops it for "as long as". The negative changes which of the two you have said.
Every conditional is answered by तो. The vocabulary here comes from Module 13's formal register block.

questions.sentence: जिस दुकान से सामान लिया, वह बंद हो गई।
questions.sentence_read_as: jis dukaan se saamaan liyaa, vah baṁd ho gaii.
options: से because the shop was closed
से because buying is done from a shop, so the relative copies that postposition
questions.explanation_en: Write the first half as a plain sentence, look at the postposition it used, and put जिस in front of it.

sentences: माहौल अलग-अलग होता है।
उसी के हिसाब से बोलना चाहिए।
options: जहाँ जैसा माहौल हो, वहाँ वैसा ही बोलना चाहिए।
जहाँ जैसा माहौल हो, वैसा ही बोलना चाहिए।
जहाँ जैसा माहौल हो, वहाँ ही बोलना चाहिए।
जैसा जहाँ माहौल हो, वैसा वहाँ बोलना चाहिए।
questions.explanation_en: Two openers need two answerers. This is also the sentence Module 15 closes on.

sentences: जो कल कहा था, वही आज भी कहता हूँ।
जो कल कहा था, वह ही आज भी कहता हूँ।
questions.explanation_en: वह and ही fuse into वही. Writing them apart is not wrong so much as never done.

sentences: किताब कहाँ है जो मैंने कल दी थी?
वह किताब कहाँ है जो मैंने कल दी थी?
options: The second — this is the correct one
questions.explanation_en: Even when the जो clause comes second, the correlative वह is still needed in front. Reversing the order does not let you drop it.

sentences: जब भी वो आते हैं, मिठाई लाते हैं।
जब भी वो आते हैं, तब भी मिठाई लाते हैं।
questions.explanation_en: तब भी exists but means "even then", which contradicts the sentence. A correlative isn't automatic just because the first half has भी.

sentences: जब वो आते हैं, तब बात करेंगे।
जब वो आएँगे, तब बात करेंगे।
options: The second — this is the correct one
questions.explanation_en: The present here says they habitually come, turning a plan into a routine — the English when-clause habit leaking into Hindi.

sentences: जहाँ हम रुके थे, वहाँ अब होटल है।
जहाँ हम रुके थे, अब होटल है।
questions.explanation_en: The same missing correlative as जो...वह and जब...तब, now in जहाँ...वहाँ.

sentences: जहाँ भी जाओ, वहाँ भी सावधानी बरतो।
जहाँ भी जाओ, सावधानी बरतो।
options: The second — this is the correct one
questions.explanation_en: वहाँ भी means "there too", which adds a second place the sentence never mentioned. The भी-hedged form takes no correlative.

sentences: अगर उन्होंने कहा है तो सही ही होगा।
अगर उन्होंने कहा है तो सही ही है।
questions.explanation_en: है asserts it flatly. होगा marks it as an inference, which is what this sentence is actually doing.

sentences: चाहे कुछ भी हो जाए, तो मैं जाऊँगा।
चाहे कुछ भी हो जाए, फिर भी मैं जाऊँगा।
options: The second — this is the correct one
questions.explanation_en: तो answers अगर and means the condition led to the result. चाहे needs फिर भी, meaning the condition did not stop the outcome.

sentences: शायद वो कल आए।
शायद वो कल आता है।
questions.explanation_en: The present makes it a habit — 'he perhaps habitually comes tomorrow'. शायद takes the subjunctive or future, never the plain present.

sentences: जल्दी निकलो ताकि ट्रेन मिल जाएगी।
जल्दी निकलो ताकि ट्रेन मिल जाए।
options: The second — this is the correct one
questions.explanation_en: The future asserts the train will be caught. ताकि states an aim, and an aim hasn't happened yet — it needs the subjunctive.

If the engine ever adds a fifth checkpoint slot for modules whose level count is not a multiple of five, this is the gap it would close.
